requirements.text: The system must allow for multiple file upload to be configured on a per-page basis.
The system must allow actors to organize their voice clips into a portfolio.
The system must allow actors to download their voice clips in a flexible format.
The system must store audio clips in a format conducive to speech.
The system must allow actors to delete recorded clips.
The system must allow web feeds to be turned on or off on a per-page basis.
An actor must be able to search through pages in a course.
The system must display a search box on every page after an actor has logged in.
A course administrator must be able to grade an assignment.
The system should display grade information to the appropriate actor.
The system should maintain a grade history.
The system must provide a wiki where actors can collaboratively create networks of documents.
The system must provide a blog engine.
The system must provide both e-mail and SMS notifications for pages.
As far as possible, the system should provide a simple, responsive interface.
The system must be backed up on a configurable schedule.
The system should be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
The system should support at least 1000 concurrent users.
The system must be maintainable without substantial modification.
Relevant, online documentation for users should be available on each page.
System administrators must have access to comprehensive, searchable documentation.
The system must encrypt all stored audio clips at rest and enforce strict access control lists ensuring only the owner and authorized instructors can access specific portfolio items.
The system must implement role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure that grade information is only accessible to the student owner and the authorized course administrator/professor.
The system must provide SMS notifications via a secure gateway, ensuring user phone numbers are not exposed to other actors and providing an opt-out mechanism for privacy compliance.
The system must ensure that all backups are encrypted at rest and stored in a secure, access-controlled environment.
The system must support 1000 concurrent users with a maximum page load time of 2 seconds for 95% of requests under peak load.
The system must have an RTO of 6 hours and an RPO of 1 hour for all course data.
The system interface must comply with WCAG 2.1 AA standards and achieve a System Usability Scale (SUS) score of at least 70 in user testing.
The system must maintain 99% availability, measured on a rolling 30-day basis, excluding scheduled maintenance windows announced 48 hours in advance.
The system must be maintainable such that 90% of standard configuration changes can be performed via the UI without modifying source code.
The system must render pages within 2 seconds under a load of 1000 concurrent users.
The system must support 1000 concurrent active sessions with a peak throughput of 50 requests per second while maintaining sub-2-second response times.
Search queries must return results within 1 second for a course containing up to 10,000 documents.
The system must support storage and retrieval of audio clips up to 50MB per student without impacting overall system latency.
